name: wehome
description: Search Wehome stays in South Korea by area, guests, and budget.

interface.longDescription: Search Wehome stays across South Korea, including Seoul, Busan, and Jeju, by area or theme, guest count, and nightly budget. Compare stays with KRW prices, ratings, and reviews, then open the listing on wehome.me, where booking and payment take place.
defaultPrompt: Find a stay near Hongdae for 2 people.
Stays in Gwangalli, Busan under 200,000 won a night.
Recommend a hanok stay in Korea.

positive.description: Search by area and guest count
positive.prompt: Find a stay near Hongdae for 2 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Wehome stay cards in the Hongdae area (Mapo-gu, Seoul) with KRW price, rating, and a link to each listing.

positive.prompt: Stays in Gwangalli, Busan under 200,000 won a night.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows stays in Suyeong-gu, Busan priced within 200,000 KRW per night.

positive.prompt: Recommend a hanok stay in Korea.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows hanok stays with location, KRW price, rating, and links.

positive.prompt: A place in Busan for 4 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Busan stays that accept 4 guests with KRW price and links.

positive.prompt: Stay near Hongdae, I will arrive late at night.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Hongdae-area stays and lists self check-in stays first when available.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Tokyo.

negative.description: Request to complete a booking or payment
negative.prompt: Book the first stay and pay with my card.
What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin only searches listings and links to wehome.me. It does not take payments or create reservations.

publication.release_notes: Reconnects the plugin to the live Wehome search service, improves area and budget filtering, and lists self check-in stays first for late arrivals.

ko-KR.subtitle: 한국 숙소 찾기
ko-KR.description: 서울·부산·제주 등 한국의 위홈 숙소를 지역·테마, 인원, 1박 예산으로 찾습니다. 원화 요금, 평점과 후기를 비교하고 위홈 숙소 페이지로 이동해 예약합니다.

ja-JP.subtitle: 韓国の宿泊先を探す
ja-JP.description: ソウル・釜山・済州など韓国のWehome宿泊施設を、エリアやテーマ、人数、1泊の予算で検索できます。ウォン建ての料金、評価、レビューを比較し、予約と支払いはwehome.meの宿泊ページで行います。

zh-TW.subtitle: 搜尋韓國住宿
zh-TW.description: 依地區或主題、人數與每晚預算，搜尋首爾、釜山、濟州等地的 Wehome 韓國住宿。比較韓元價格、評分與評論，再前往 wehome.me 的住宿頁面完成預訂與付款。
